name: minimind
description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
one_liner: A tiny, free tutorial project that teaches you how to build and train your own miniature AI language model from scratch in a couple of hours.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is an educational/research project, not a commercial product.
business_use_cases: A university instructor uses it as hands-on coursework to teach students how LLMs actually work under the hood.
A corporate trainer builds a paid 'understand AI from first principles' workshop for non-ML engineers using this as the lab exercise.
A content creator makes a paid video course walking people through building their own tiny LLM using this project.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell an educational workshop or video course teaching people to use this to build their own mini LLM

steal_this: Turn it into a weekend paid workshop, 'Build Your Own AI From Scratch in an Afternoon', charging a flat fee per seat.
